what: One second-reader pass on the invented visit, answered by the cloud model through the page. Invented people only. The bytes the reader read are the bytes the browser sent.
countsNote: bytesToModel and requestsToModel count the call to the cloud model alone (bytesLeft is the same number). bytesIncludingAppCheck and requestsIncludingAppCheck count every request that had a body during the press, the App Check exchange included. The page shows both, each under its own words.
